remarks: This is a sleek architectural home with a serene sophistication in prime Santa Monica location. Lots of light comes through the large windows into the open floor plan. About 1500 sq ft, two bedrooms, 2.5 baths- all with high-end finishes. Rich mahogany hardwood floors compliment the Italian tile flooring. The large gourmet kitchen showcases natural stone countertops, stainless appliances with a long bar/counter. The master bedroom feels open with vaulted ceilings, walk-in closet. Extra deep euro-style tubs for soaking and dual sink in the master bathroom. The peaceful lush garden enclosed patio or the sunny roof deck offers places to unwind.
